commitMessages:
test(release): align prerequisite fitness checks

Verify package defaults and explicit source property fixtures after module
tool adoption. Refresh current source receipts while preserving historical
approvals, and retain direct-reference onboarding safeguards.

ci: allow time for blocking Aspire tests

Cold setup used 470 seconds of the 600-second whole-job limit, leaving
insufficient time for host startup and test results. Use the supported
30-minute allowance while retaining the blocking test policy.
